By Yahweh’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.
He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.
You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.
You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.
You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.
In that day, Yahweh with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan…
The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole…

translations.web: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.
translations.bsb: By His breath the skies were cleared; His hand pierced the fleeing serpent.
translations.kjv: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.
translations.asv: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished; His hand hath pierced the swift serpent.
